description: This file contains unit tests for the NetworkManager plugin, specifically testing various network interface configurations, IP settings, and interface state management using the Google Test framework. It uses mock objects to simulate interactions with the underlying libnm library and verifies the plugin's behavior in different scenarios.

classes.name: NetworkManagerTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for setting up and tearing down the environment necessary for testing the NetworkManager plugin, including mock objects and test dependencies.
